pipeline: PyTorch -> ONNX (no CBAM) -> onnx2tf flatbuffer_direct -> INT8 TFLite
cbam_removal_note: CBAM channel attention uses view(B,C,1,1)*x broadcast which breaks all ONNX-to-TFLite converters during NCHW->NHWC conversion. Replaced with Identity at export time (no retraining).

accuracy_drop_cbam_removal.note: Without retraining. Retraining without CBAM would likely recover most of this.

accuracy_drop_int8_quant.note: FP32 TFLite vs INT8 TFLite. May improve with more calibration samples.
